moat_against: The ACC caps the economics: the pending rate case requests a 10.70% ROE and ~$611M net revenue increase with a ~14.75% day-one bill impact — recovery can be trimmed, lagged or politicized (the ACC's rooftop-solar surcharge was vacated by the Arizona Court of Appeals in June 2026)
Measured returns are thin: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json runs 4.09%-5.32% over FY2021-FY2025 and ROE 8.28%-10.77% — at or below the cost of capital, as regulated returns are designed to be

Growth is debt- plus equity-funded: net debt $10,556M plus $3,737M lease liabilities, and $1.0B-$1.2B of new equity financing planned through 2028; share count already grows +2.45%/yr, diluting rate-base growth per share
Extreme-heat / wildfire / water exposure in the Arizona service territory and Palo Verde concentration raise physical and remediation cost tails that sit with equity if recovery is denied
moat_for: Exclusive regulated electric franchise in one of the fastest-growing US service territories — APS customer growth 2.1% in Q2 2026, weather-normalized sales growth 5.6%, long-term weather-normalized sales growth guided 5%-7% through 2030
Palo Verde nuclear station — APS-operated, the largest US nuclear plant — gives low-marginal-cost baseload, with 20-year license renewals sought through 2065-2067
Semiconductor and large-load expansion in the Phoenix metro drives commercial load growth on top of residential growth — total sales +9.6% in Q2 2026
Essential, inelastic demand with a 12-year dividend growth record (fundamentals.json) and a $10.35B 2025-2028 capital plan that enters rate base and earns regulated returns once recovered
moat_justification: Exclusive regulated electric franchise (Arizona Public Service) in a top-growth territory — customer growth 2.1% and weather-normalized sales +5.6% in Q2 2026, 5%-7% sales growth guided through 2030, semiconductor/large-load demand, and Palo Verde baseload — a durable, visible compounding machine. Capped at 6 because the Arizona Corporation Commission sets the allowed return (pending case requests 10.70% ROE; measured roic_proxy is only 4.09%-5.32% over FY2021-FY2025, at/below the cost of capital through the cycle), there is no pricing power beyond rate cases, and the build is funded with debt (net debt $10,556M) plus $1.0B-$1.2B of planned equity issuance on a share count already growing +2.45%/yr.
name: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation
one_liner: Durable AZ regulated monopoly with top-tier load growth, moat 6/10, but conservative owner's earnings are negative in all of the last 5 years and on TTM (capex exceeds OCF; normalized base -$5.76/share, TTM -$7.30/share) — Tier F on this screen; guided 5-7% EPS growth plus a ~3.5% dividend yield does not clear 15% and no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
